desc:
Welcome to HIGHFORCE RACING — an immersive UK street racing experience. 🇬🇧

Take to the roads, explore a detailed UK-inspired road network, and experience the thrill of driving through the city day and night.

🏎️ High-Speed Racing
🛣️ UK-Inspired Roads & Streets
🎵 Cinematic Atmosphere
🌆 Night-Time Driving Experience
🔥 Race. Explore. Push Hard.

Whether you're cruising through the streets at night, testing your car's limits, or battling other drivers, HIGHFORCE RACING is built around the freedom and atmosphere of UK street driving.

Drive safely. Race hard. Have fun.

Made by Skowess and Niki
Map made by Paul

HIGHFORCE RACING — OWN THE ROAD. 🏁🇬🇧
